subject.title: Feature: Auto session split when approaching context window limit

question: Should OpenClaw add a core context-pressure auto-rollover policy, and what public config/defaults/continuity contract should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding automatic rollover changes public session configuration and persistent routing semantics, so automation should not choose thresholds, defaults, handoff storage, or delivery behavior without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Default-Off Core Rollover
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design thread and specify a default-off session.contextRollover-style policy before implementation.

options.title: Scope To Existing Compaction
options.body: Avoid new session rollover for now and improve compaction/memory-flush/status behavior instead, preserving the current session lifecycle contract.

options.title: Split By Trigger Family
options.body: Keep token-pressure rollover here and track age/turn TTL separately in the existing TTL issue so the two policies do not drift.

recommendation.title: Design Default-Off Core Rollover
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical design thread and specify a default-off session.contextRollover-style policy before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history ties are daily reset and pre-compaction memory flush, which are the baseline policies this request would extend.
